Split morning, then a private wine tour

Day 03 · Wednesday Today

September 30

A free day in Sonoma

Nothing scheduled until dinner. A slow morning, a hike or a coast drive, lunch or a bar snack at Layla downstairs, then a walk to Cafe La Haye.

OpenIdeas for the dayNo wrong answer here. Jenner is about an hour and 15 minutes from the hotel, so make a day of it if you head for the coast.
  • A drive out to the Sonoma coast, Bodega Bay and Highway 1
  • Coastal hike: the Kortum Trail from Shell Beach, an easy bluff-top walk toward Goat Rock, just south of Jenner Map
  • Coastal hike: Jenner Headlands Preserve, a bigger climb with huge views over the mouth of the Russian River Map
  • A hike closer to home at Jack London State Historic Park or Sonoma Valley Regional Park
  • Walk-in tastings around the Sonoma Plaza
  • Lunch, or a drink and a few plates, at Layla downstairs from your room. No reservation needed
7:15 PMDinner at Cafe La Haye✓ ConfirmedSonoma institution, tiny room, seasonal Northern California cooking. No driving, no logistics, just a really lovely local night.140 E Napa Street, Sonoma, CA 95476 MapRight off the Plaza, a short walk from the hotelTable for 2 · Booked under Craig HarperCall 707-935-5994Confirmed directly with the restaurant

October 1

Healdsburg day, then Glen Ellen Star

A self-guided day up in Healdsburg, about an hour north, a straight shot up 12 and 101: a tasting, a late lunch, shopping around the square, and an afternoon stop at the Siduri tasting room. Head back down by about 6:00 PM for dinner at Glen Ellen Star.

The Fine Print

Good to know

Layla, downstairs

The hotel restaurant is right below your room. It is closed for dinner Monday and Tuesday, so think lunch one afternoon, or drinks and a few plates at the bar. No reservation needed.

Spa hours

Spa amenities are open 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Monday to Thursday and 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Friday to Sunday: indoor lounge, locker rooms, the outdoor relaxation garden with whirlpool and co-ed steam room, and a fitness room with Peloton bikes, a Woodway treadmill and TRX.

Pool

The pool and outdoor whirlpool are open 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM daily.

Tipping on the wine tour

Gratuities for your Bohemian Highway driver and the winery hosts are not included. They are at your discretion.

After tastings

Please don’t drive after tastings. Tuesday is fully driven for you. For everything else, a ride share is the easy call.

Healdsburg on Thursday

You chose a ride share each way over a driver, which makes sense. It is about 45 minutes in each direction, so request the ride back with a little buffer before dinner.
